name: vendor-repo
description: Vendor dependency source as squashed git subtrees under repos/, pinned to the installed version, so coding agents read real library code.

scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
scripts.test:dist: bun run build && VENDOR_REPO_BIN=dist/vendor-repo.js bun test vendor-repo.integration.test.ts
